title: Copilot Studio: share autonomous agents with end users (run-only)
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap targets, run-only setup, recipient licensing and environment billing are supported. The cited documentation is accessible despite the earlier rate-limit errors; minor corrections would complete two navigation paths and acknowledge Microsoft's alternate embedded-credentials configuration route.

The roadmap says autonomous agents previously could only be used and managed by makers.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes sharing automation with end users without edit permissions or ownership.
claims.quote: Run-only sharing enables makers to securely share autonomous agents with end users, allowing users to benefit from agent-driven automation without requiring edit permissions or ownership.
